description.narrative: (USAID Bureau for Inclusive Growth, Partnerships, and Innovation (IPI)): .With FY 2024 resources, USAID expects to address barriers associated with access, affordability, equity, cost-effectiveness, product-market fit, pathways to scale, and/or financial sustainability for increasing supply and uptake of low-cost, durable, and adjustable bicycles to improve mobility in sub-Saharan Africa, contributing to enhanced economic opportunities, improved household productivity, and increased access to essential services..
